# Step 13 — Demo footage & submission

**PRD:** §1.1, §5.1–5.2, §8, §27, §28, §29 · **Depends on:** everything

## Footage (start early — steps 03, 05, 06 need it)

1. Small room you control; measure floor (metres), landmarks, shelf/desk/door positions, camera mounts.
2. Two fixed cameras (phones on tripods are fine), partly overlapping; one is enough for the first baseline.
3. Distinct consented objects: blue equipment case, red tool pouch, labelled parcel, and one lookalike.
4. Up to three consenting actors; signed consent recorded in `docs/DATA_RIGHTS.md` (kept out of the public repo).
5. Record a clock-sync event (e.g. clap / light flash visible in both views).
6. Record scenarios C01–C10; ground-truth labels go to the evaluation store only 🔒.

## Submission checklist

- [ ] Public repo, no secrets, no unconsented footage; demo clips licensed for publication.
- [ ] README: problem, run steps, architecture, real vs simulated table (§27.1), evaluation snapshot, limitations.
- [ ] Docs: DECISIONS, DEPENDENCIES, META_MODEL_USAGE, DATA_RIGHTS, CALIBRATION, EVIDENCE_SCHEMA, EVALUATION,
      PRIVACY, NEW_WORK, LIMITATIONS.
- [ ] 3-minute video showing work made during the hackathon.
- [ ] Rubric weighting confirmed in Discord (25×4 vs 30/25/20/25) — §1.2.
- [ ] Track/team enrolment confirmed.
- [ ] Every item in PRD §29 invariants checklist ticked.
